cells.rationale: The latest first print was exactly 203,000 (DOL, https://www.dol.gov/ui/data.pdf, 2026-11-19), which would resolve No on a repeat, and the 4-week average is 197,750 with only 2 of the last 12 weeks above 203,000. Against that, claims have risen from 191,000 to 202,000 to 203,000 and the prior week was revised up 2,000, so a first print of 204,000 or more is plausible. The pre-Thanksgiving week a year earlier dipped 6,000 (https://www.calculatedriskblog.com/2025/11/weekly-initial-unemployment-claims_26.html?m=1, 2025-11-26). I expect a first print centered near 201,000 with a spread of about 6,000.

note: Recorded before every entry's cutoff; scored as a separate method.
